mapper.select: SELECT name FROM nw_tenants WHERE id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
SELECT display_name,logo_url,primary_color,contact_email,support_url,revision FROM nw_foundation_tenant_branding WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_tenant_branding(tenant_id,display_name,logo_url,primary_color,contact_email,support_url,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),#{command.displayName},#{command.logoUrl},#{command.primaryColor},#{command.contactEmail},#{command.supportUrl},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_tenant_branding SET display_name=#{command.displayName},logo_url=#{command.logoUrl},primary_color=#{command.primaryColor},contact_email=#{command.contactEmail},support_url=#{command.supportUrl},revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by=#{actor} WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT theme,locale,page_size,compact_navigation,revision FROM nw_foundation_personal_preferences WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_personal_preferences(owner_key,tenant_id,member_id,theme,locale,page_size,compact_navigation) VALUES(#{owner},CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),#{member},#{command.theme},#{command.locale},#{command.pageSize},#{command.compactNavigation}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_personal_preferences SET theme=#{command.theme},locale=#{command.locale},page_size=#{command.pageSize},compact_navigation=#{command.compactNavigation},revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND member_id=#{member} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
